title: Absolute expectation of a random restriction
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $0\leq\delta\leq1$, and let $g$ assign a real-valued function on each fixed sign cube indexed by a subset of the $n$ coordinates. The absolute value of the expectation of $g$ over a random restriction is at most the random-restriction expectation of the pointwise absolute value of $g$.
hypotheses_covered: $g$ is a real-valued function on each fixed sign cube, for every subset of the coordinates
